scripts.admin:add: npx wrangler d1 execute DB --command "update users set role='admin' where email='your-admin-user@gmail.com'"
scripts.check:users: npx wrangler d1 execute DB --command "select * from users"
scripts.check:crudl: npx wrangler d1 execute DB --command "select * from crudl_items"
scripts.check:tables: npx wrangler d1 execute DB --command "PRAGMA table_list"
scripts.db:better-auth:all: npm run db:better-auth:schema && npm run db:better-auth:generate && npm run db:better-auth:migrate
scripts.db:better-auth:all-remote: npm run db:better-auth:schema && npm run db:better-auth:generate && npm run db:better-auth:migrate-remote
scripts.deploy: export CLOUDFLARE_ENV=production; npm run build && wrangler deploy --env=production
